prose: Basis: the author's Show HN description; the page itself returned almost no readable text. As a personal benchmark - 'sort of my personal version of Simon Willison's pelican-on-a-bicycle metric' - the author has frontier models build self-contained web pages displaying clocks.
Claude Opus 5.5 impressed enough that over several sessions the author had it create 500 clocks, collected in a single 6.3MB HTML file, with Claude's own summary of the prompting process alongside.
